result.stdout:
usage: onegame <verb> [options]

  help       List the commands and options.
  new        Create a game: onegame new <name> [--server] [--dir <folder>] [--engine <checkout>]; --server adds a dedicated-server project. Without --engine or ONEGAME_ROOT the game builds from the RecursiveAI.OneGame.Sdk package.
  keys       Make a key pair for a server or player: keys [--out DIR] [--name NAME] [--force]. Writes NAME.key (SECRET) and NAME.pub (share it); prints the public key.
  build      Build the game in this folder (Debug; --release for Release).
  run        Build and run the game; a Debug run is hot (C# edits apply while it runs; --no-hot turns that off). --headless --frames N, --size, --seed, --live [socket], -- <game options>.
  test       Run scenarios (scenarios/*.yaml) in a headless game, and the game's C# test projects. --scenario <file>, --update-references, --no-unit.
  capture    Capture a frame (--out file.png --size 720p --scale 1 --after N) or a sequence (--sequence dir --count N --every T).
  replay     Replay a recording (onegame replay run.ogrp) and compare the state hash of every tick.
  mcp        MCP server on stdio for a running Debug game: --socket <path>, or --project <dir> to start one, or no option to attach to the only live game; --cluster <file|folder> serves every node of a process cluster (tools take a 'node' argument).
  export     Package the game: onegame export --target linux|win|osx|web [--steam] [--out <dir>] [--no-archive] [--no-aot]; or its dedicated server: export --server [--plugins]; or a debug-signed APK: export --target android [--abi arm64-v8a,x86_64] [--dev] [--package id]; or an iOS app bundle (on a Mac): export --target ios-simulator|ios [--dev] [--bundle-id id] [--orientation all|landscape|portrait].
  web        Run a game in headless Chrome: web test [--scenario <folder>] [--dir <exported folder>] [--profile <folder> --port N: keep the browser profile, so saved files survive to the next run; the same port keeps the same web origin] [--tolerance N] [--max-diff F] [--t
